dialect.detail: Micro Focus / GnuCOBOL dialect with $set compiler directive (LINKCOUNT, GNT), COMP-5 usage, CRT STATUS, CURSOR IS, CONSOLE IS CRT — typical of Micro Focus COBOL or GnuCOBOL targeting MF compatibility. Program by J.W. Lemmon (CSS), version 9.04.05 June 2018, GPL-licensed accounting/creditor system.
evidence: COPY with .SL and .FDE extensions typical of MF/GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: Creditor (accounts payable) cheques issued report/processing module in a small business accounting system
purpose.summary: CRP019 is a creditor cheques-issued program that processes and reports on cheques issued to creditors (accounts payable). It handles screen display, printer output with aging buckets (30/60/90/120/150/180 days), and interacts with creditor, transaction, department, and parameter files. It is part of a larger GPL-licensed accounting suite by J.W. Lemmon.

notable_features: 51 COPY statements for modular file/screen definitions
CRT STATUS / CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT (screen handling)
REDEFINES for multiple print line layouts
GPL license embedded in SECURITY paragraph
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1720 lines. Dialect is consistent with Micro Focus COBOL or GnuCOBOL with MF compatibility mode. The $set directive and .GNT extension strongly indicate GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus. Long development history (1983–2018) and extensive structure confirm production-grade software.
